stem: The domino theory, which provided the basis for U.S. entry into the Vietnam War, was the belief that intervention was necessary to prevent —

options.label: F
options.text: the expansion of communism across Southeast Asia

options.label: G
options.text: the inclusion of Taiwan in the Warsaw Pact

options.label: H
options.text: the loss of UN military bases in Asia

options.label: J
options.text: the rise of China as a dominant economic power
